first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, making simplification the most direct response and more sustainable than broad discounting. Verify the prior onboarding result and the evidence for promotional pricing before committing, while measuring qualified activation, retention, and revenue—not completion alone—to detect downstream value dilution.

final.rationale: Use a standard, guarded onboarding-simplification experiment because the verified result directly addresses the current 4% completion decline and likely contributes to the 6% activation decline, while also improving time-to-value and 30-day retention. Do not use promotional pricing: although it lifted qualified revenue short term, the 12% retention decline indicates poor sustainable value. Evaluate qualified activation, time-to-value, 30-day retention, renewal quality, and revenue—not completion alone.
